races.name: SSP Signs & Graphics Handicap
races.verdict:
ARCHER'S GRACE has been off since a promising fourth at Salisbury on her handicap debut in May but that form has worked out well so this well-bred filly could be worth chancing. Toastmaster is next best back down in class ahead of Berlinetta.

  1. ARCHER'S GRACE (IRE)
  2. TOASTMASTER (IRE)
  3. BERLINETTA

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WATCH PARTY showed plenty to work on in what was probably a decent newcomers event at Newmarket and she can put that experience to good use up against well-connected debutants Sea La Roma and You're Sensational.

  1. WATCH PARTY (IRE)
  2. SEA LA ROMA (IRE)
  3. YOU'RE SENSATIONAL

races.name: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FLICK OF AN EYE ran to a high level for a newcomer when third at Newbury and should take the beating. I Am Royal and Channel Islands have both shown enough to suggest they can win a novice so can follow the selection home.

  1. FLICK OF AN EYE (IRE)
  2. I AM ROYAL (IRE)
  3. CHANNEL ISLANDS (IRE)

races.name: 'GRC 30' Anniversary Of Yarmouth' Nursery
races.verdict:
JAVELOT justified his position at the head of the betting at Wolverhampton 4 weeks ago and with that form looking better now than it did at the time, it's easy to construct a strong case for him from a handicapping perspective. Asgar is ready for 7f and is a threat, while a gelding operation may help Indian Land step forward.

  1. JAVELOT
  2. ASGAR (IRE)
  3. INDIAN LAND

races.name: Thurlow Nunn Standen Groundcare Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
HAMLET'S NIGHT is capable of doing some damage from this Flat mark given his hurdles ability so he's marginally preferred to Echalar, who showed a sharp turn of foot when getting the job done at Doncaster last time.

  1. HAMLET'S NIGHT (IRE)
  2. ECHALAR (IRE)
  3. ARTHUR'S REALM (IRE)

races.name: Goffs Two Million Series Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
SPACE BEAR has responded really well to positive tactics of late and representing a yard in excellent form, it's easy enough to construct a case for her dominating these. Miss Nightcap has more to offer as a handicapper so is feared most, ahead of the reliable Powdering.

  1. SPACE BEAR (IRE)
  2. MISS NIGHTCAP
  3. POWDERING (IRE)

races.name: Winning Experience With Moulton Racing Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks an interesting race for the field size, with FIORELLA PRINCESS just about the most persuasive option following a promising start for Robert Cowell 4 weeks ago. Creative Queen was better than the result last time and she's bubbling under, while the assessor has given Twilight Fun a major chance from this turf mark.

  1. FIORELLA PRINCESS (IRE)
  2. CREATIVE QUEEN (USA)
  3. TWILIGHT FUN

races.name: Support Scropton Riding For The Disabled Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Preference is for HARRY, who has acquitted himself well in a couple of outings for David Pipe and figures off a handy mark. Betty's Tiara and Torrent can also make their presence felt.

  1. HARRY (SWE)
  2. BETTY'S TIARA
  3. TORRENT

races.name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TIME IN A BOTTLE sets the standard on these terms starting out for Dan Skelton, though strong claims can also be made for Jentobello and Martymill.

  1. TIME IN A BOTTLE
  2. JENTOBELLO
  3. MARTYMILL (IRE)

races.name: Taverna Nights On Saturday 26th September Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Three-time hurdles winner ICE JET has made a positive start over the larger obstacles and can open his account in this sphere. Chase debutant Dream Diamond may give him most to think about.

  1. ICE JET (IRE)
  2. DREAM DIAMOND (IRE)
  3. SUPREME GEORGE (IRE)

races.name: Pip & Chris Emerald Wedding Anniversary Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
PHANTOM GOLD remains unexposed and the form of his Worcester victory has worked out well. He can make a successful debut for new connections. His old rival Royal Rhythm and October Hill are also of interest.

  1. PHANTOM GOLD (IRE)
  2. ROYAL RHYTHM (IRE)
  3. OCTOBER HILL (IRE)

races.name: Ready Freddie Go Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
AXEL BLEUE is a chaser on the up and still looks on a workable mark. He can register his third victory of the season. Light N Strike could prove dangerous if the return to Emma Lavelle sparks a revival in form, whilst the consistent Grand Clermont is also much respected.

  1. AXEL BLEUE
  2. LIGHT N STRIKE (IRE)
  3. GRAND CLERMONT (FR)

races.name: Sun Racing The Favourite Pullout Every Day Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TIME INTERVAL badly lost his way towards the end of last season but has become well handicapped on old form as a result and, having made a notable yard switch and undergone a second breathing operation, he's taken to revive. Latin would have pushed the winner closest but for a calamitous error 2 out on his handicap debut/final start for James Owen at Stratford and remains with potential, while Lady Dapple Rose completes the shortlist.

  1. TIME INTERVAL
  2. LATIN (IRE)
  3. LADY DAPPLE ROSE (IRE)

races.name: QuinnBet Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A 3-time winner in France, MARTIN'S DENUO made a better fist of things than he had on British debut when second in a small-field handicap chase at Fontwell 9 days ago. In receipt of a handy 4-y-o allowance, he shades preference back at this slightly shorter trip. Top weight Gaelic Rambler ought to be suited by the drop in distance and is feared, whilst Hudson is potentially well handicapped on the pick of his hurdles form.

  1. MARTIN'S DENUO (FR)
  2. GAELIC RAMBLER (IRE)
  3. HUDSON (FR)

races.name: racingtv.com Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BLAKE'S MONARCH ran well considering how close he raced to the strong pace when midfield in the Norfolk Stakes at Royal Ascot in June and, following a subsequent breathing operation (also gelded), he's fancied to make a bold bid returned to much calmer waters. Karl Burke's Mugheer who made a winning debut at Catterick is an obvious danger. Paphos and Cyberspace can do best of the others.

  1. BLAKE'S MONARCH (IRE)
  2. MUGHEER (IRE)
  3. PAPHOS (IRE)

races.name: Watch RacingTV Free For 31 Days Selling Stakes
races.verdict:
A wide-open seller. LADY DUBLIN may prove good enough to defy top weight, with Maximus Meridius second choice ahead of Fern Clyde.

  1. LADY DUBLIN
  2. MAXIMUS MERIDIUS (IRE)
  3. FERN CLYDE

races.name: Marske Fabrication And Engineering Straight Mile Handicap
races.verdict:
BLUE BOY JUNIOR very much caught the eye when fifth on his qualifying run at Southwell 4 weeks ago, keeping on without being knocked about. He appeals as the type to go on improving now handicapping and earns the vote over last year's winner Just Typical. Law of Design and Harswell Ruby are others to merit a second look, too.

  1. BLUE BOY JUNIOR (IRE)
  2. JUST TYPICAL
  3. LAW OF DESIGN (IRE)

races.name: Start Your RacingTV Free Trial Now Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty to consider with the vote going to MAGIC BOY, who looked a shade unlucky not to justify market confidence in a big field at Ripon last month. Grant Wood shaped well in the same race and is threatening to come good soon, with 3-y-os Return of The Gods and Straight Ahead also on the shortlist.

  1. MAGIC BOY (GER)
  2. GRANT WOOD (IRE)
  3. RETURN OF THE GODS (IRE)

races.name: Market Cross Jewellers Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
It wasn't the strongest of contests by any means that saw SUPPLICATE bring up the 4-timer at Salisbury last month but she still got the job done in straightforward fashion and, clearly on a roll for her leading connections, looks a leading player again taking on her elders for the first time. Pol Roger and Obito are 2 of the older brigade who arrive in rude health and command plenty of respect, with Newbury scorer Magical Merlot another in the mix.

  1. SUPPLICATE
  2. POL ROGER (IRE)
  3. OBITO (IRE)

races.name: Try RacingTV Free Now At racingtv.com/freetrial Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
DRAGON SPIN has been hindered by slow starts on each of her last 2 outings but this is a welcome ease in class for Steph Hollinshead's filly and operating just 1 lb above her last winning mark, she could be worth chancing to bounce back under Clifford Lee. Startling is a really admirable filly and can make her presence felt again, with Canaria Queen and All Good others worth a look.

  1. DRAGON SPIN
  2. STARTLING
  3. CANARIA QUEEN

races.name: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Handicap
races.verdict:
SPEEDING BULLET dropped his biggest hint for a while that he's ready to strike from a much-reduced mark when runner up at Newcastle 12 days ago and could be worth chancing for all his high draw makes things tricky. Golden Havana has been given a break following a lesser run at Musselburgh and appeals as the type to bounce back. Albegone, Dc Cogent and Betweenthesticks are others to consider in a competitive finale.

  1. SPEEDING BULLET (IRE)
  2. GOLDEN HAVANA (IRE)
  3. ALBEGONE

races.name: Cavani Fashion Forward Handicap
races.verdict:
In the hope the market vibes are more positive than has been the case for a while. EM JAY KAY looks a very attractive proposition from his lowly mark returned to this C&D. Candy Warhol and Trust Sergei are solid rivals.

  1. EM JAY KAY
  2. CANDY WARHOL (USA)
  3. TRUST SERGEI

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com 'Confined' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
THAMES WATERMAN has presumably had an issue to have been off since his winning debut here in the spring but he's in very capable hands and this looks a good opening if all is well. Darjeel and Picnic Princess are expected to make above-average improvement on second start and head the dangers unless Kitty Rey is backed on debut.

  1. THAMES WATERMAN
  2. DARJEEL (AUS)
  3. PICNIC PRINCESS

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com 'Confined' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
In keeping with several James Fanshawe juveniles this season, TREDEGAR SQUARE was well prepared to make a winning debut at Kempton a month ago and his follow-up claims under a penalty appear to be bright. Find Your Fire has work to do with the selection on that clash but he was hampered and he too is open to progress, with Marhaba Ya Tayib and Birkett Bank likely-looking newcomers on paper.

  1. TREDEGAR SQUARE
  2. FIND YOUR FIRE (IRE)
  3. MARHABA YA TAYIB (IRE)

races.name: Race & Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not a strong novice by any means so appealing newcomer INKBERROW is offered up from a stable more than capable of readying one first time up before the benefit of market clues. The returning Not That Guy and likely improver Iron Dome are other key players.

  1. INKBERROW (IRE)
  2. NOT THAT GUY (IRE)
  3. IRON DOME

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
Having opened her account at Kempton 2 starts back, PIAZZA fully backed up that effort when finishing runner up at Yarmouth 16 days ago and looks to hold solid claims again in this lower grade. Justice Court and Rogue Exile each need to shrug off below-par efforts but remain less exposed than most and head up the dangers.

  1. PIAZZA
  2. JUSTICE COURT (IRE)
  3. ROGUE EXILE (IRE)

races.name: Book Hotel And Conferencing At Wolverhampton Handicap
races.verdict:
AMARACHI responded well to this headgear when a wide-margin winner at Bath on Saturday so looks the one to beat under a penalty. R P McMurphy and Captive Beauty both shaped well over 7f last time so they head the dangers.

  1. AMARACHI (IRE)
  2. R P MCMURPHY
  3. CAPTIVE BEAUTY (IRE)

races.name: Cavani Style & Speed Handicap
races.verdict:
STIPULATION won this race last year off a similar mark so could be worth chancing having shaped well at Chepstow last time. Ballybunion is a likely danger if seeing out this longer trip, while Have You A Minute is also shortlisted after his encouraging second at Southwell.

  1. STIPULATION (IRE)
  2. BALLYBUNION (IRE)
  3. HAVE YOU A MINUTE

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
LITTLE JAYBEE continued his good start for current yard when finding only a thriving sort too good at Lingfield last week and looks ready to strike. Harry Mole and Dragon God also arrive in good heart and they head the dangers.

  1. LITTLE JAYBEE
  2. HARRY MOLE
  3. DRAGON GOD

races.name: Download The Racecourse App Raceday-Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
SAXOPHONIC has unquestionably been a flop considering his pedigree and price tag, but left the impression a step up to 1¾m may prove beneficial at Ffos Las on his most recent outing and could be up to opening his account from a basement mark. Dinah Myte is unpenalised for last week's Leicester win so is an obvious threat if staying the longer trip, while Le Rouge Chinois has been placed on all 3 starts for his current yard and can continue in form.

  1. SAXOPHONIC
  2. DINAH MYTE
  3. LE ROUGE CHINOIS (DEN)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
EXCEPTIONALLY and Silver Kiss have had a few chances but look the pair to focus on, with Aidan O'Brien's filly taken to get off the mark down in class. Harita might be the pick of the newcomers.

  1. EXCEPTIONALLY (USA)
  2. SILVER KISS (IRE)
  3. HARITA

races.name: Punchestown Is Back Maiden
races.verdict:
Preference is for NOBLE EXHIBIT, who was a promising third on debut at the Curragh last month and looks sure to improve for the step up in trip. Francillon and Dancinginthecity rate the principal dangers.

  1. NOBLE EXHIBIT (IRE)
  2. FRANCILLON
  3. DANCINGINTHECITY (IRE)

races.name: Punchestown Jumps Opener October 13th Handicap
races.verdict:
The assessor has been very fair with ZARAAHMANDO dropping him 2 lb on the back of another very solid effort so's selected to get off the mark for the season. 3-y-os Flash of Fire (starting out for an excellent yard) and Motta Alta have bigger efforts in them so must command respect.

  1. ZARAAHMANDO (IRE)
  2. FLASH OF FIRE
  3. MOTTA ALTA (IRE)

races.name: Punchestown Premiere Weekend November 21st & 22nd Race
races.verdict:
MINELLA ROCKETT is thriving at present and is taken to extend his winning sequence to 4, perhaps at the expense of lightly-raced 4-y-o Queen of The Bogs, who shaped well on her reappearance at Fairyhouse in June. Puppet Master has opened his account over hurdles since last seen on the Flat, so it's reasonable to expect a better showing on return to this code.

  1. MINELLA ROCKETT (IRE)
  2. QUEEN OF THE BOGS (IRE)
  3. PUPPET MASTER (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
races.verdict:
BACK STRAIGHT made a promising start when splitting a pair of Aidan O'Brien's better 3-y-os here 12 months ago and is the obvious call fitted with a tongue tie in the hope all is well. Xirivella could be the danger, ahead of Fleur de Provence.

  1. BACK STRAIGHT
  2. XIRIVELLA (IRE)
  3. FLEUR DE PROVENCE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
SWEET BABY ZOU looks capable of adding to her sole success before the season is out judged on her last 2 performances under her young claimer and gets the vote in a tricky handicap. Galway winner Rest Your Mind, Lady Arwen and Areana are a trio of the other likely contenders.

  1. SWEET BABY ZOU
  2. REST YOUR MIND (IRE)
  3. LADY ARWEN

races.name: Festival 2027 On Sale Soon Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SPIRITOFTHEDAWN clearly has something in hand of her basement mark judged on her fine effort at Navan on her handicap debut and won't be far away again if building on that performance. Rampage is a big danger after his Gowran near-miss, with Lohengrin another to consider after his narrow defeat at Laytown.

  1. SPIRITOFTHEDAWN (IRE)
  2. RAMPAGE (IRE)
  3. LOHENGRIN

races.name: Festival 2027 On Sale Soon Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
BELIEVE BELIEVE came close to landing a gamble at Gowran on his return in May, and although he's been absent again since, it's likely he has a race or two in him and looks the way to go. Medieval Night, Pinball Wizard and Miss Americana are dangers.

  1. BELIEVE BELIEVE (IRE)
  2. MEDIEVAL NIGHT (IRE)
  3. PINBALL WIZARD (IRE)
